title: Freeze and falsify the Form-4 research protocol
goal: Freeze signal, universe, entry, exit, holding period, sizing, costs, FX and exclusions before reading validation outcomes; evaluate out of sample against declared baselines and publish positive or negative results without post-hoc selection.

approval.note: User authorised autonomous repository implementation on 2026-08-06. Real orders, broker/wallet access, paid data purchases and capital deployment remain excluded.

acceptance.assertion: Signal, universe, entry latency, exit, holding period, sizing, fees, slippage, FX, missing-data policy and exclusions are hash-frozen before validation outcomes.
Development, validation and prospective-shadow periods are separated and future corrections cannot rewrite earlier decisions.
Compare broad buy-and-hold, matched equal-weight, simple momentum, all eligible Form-4 purchases and matched random controls.
Report doubled costs, one-trading-day delay, illiquidity exclusions, removal of ten best trades and regime/year slices.
Output is no-go, continue-shadow or independent-review request, never automatic real-capital authority.
